worldcombat.skill.electroball.summary: Charge your speed advantage over the target into an electric orb and hurl it: the faster you are, the bigger and brighter the orb and the harder it bursts. It is Gyro Ball's mirror — the same scale, now measuring your own speed and sending it far away.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.use.0: A long-range cannon when you are faster than the target
worldcombat.skill.electroball.use.1: Open fire from beyond the target's reach
worldcombat.skill.electroball.use.2: Let the speed ratio grow the orb on screen
worldcombat.skill.electroball.descriptio: The orb deals about %1$s power; the current load is %2$s (your speed / target speed), and a higher load makes the orb bigger and harder. The target's Sp. Defence, type and crits settle on hit.
It is thrown up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, with a %3$s-block orb radius.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.overcharge: Overcharge form: power x1.12 and radius x1.2, but a heavier orb flying at x0.85 (easier to walk out of), +2 ticks wind-up and +6 ticks cooldown.
Light form (native): flies fast, casts fast and recovers cleanly at slightly lower power.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.growth.0: From level %1$s the orb power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.growth.1: From level %1$s the orb power rises to %2$s and the throw reaches %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.electroball.preference: On: higher power and radius, but a heavier orb flying slower (easier to walk out of) with longer wind-up and cooldown. Off (default): light form, flying and casting fast and recovering cleanly at slightly lower power.
Only throw at a target within this range; closer in first beyond it. Large values suit a kiting companion, small ones wait for the target to close.
